reasoning: A waving flag on a pole with a centered solid circle is universally recognized as the flag of Japan (Hinomaru). It is an ideal icon for tasks about traveling to Japan, studying the Japanese language, or dealing with Japanese administration and imports, though it can occasionally double as a generic milestone flag.
